newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Four dead, 15 missing after S.African mine mudlside.
newsitem.headline: Four dead, 15 missing after S.African mine mudlside.

text.p: Four miners were killed and 15 were missing, feared dead, after heavy rain caused a mudslide at a diamond mine in South Africa's Free State province, police said on Thursday.
Mine officials said there was little hope that 15 missing miners would be found alive.

"With all the examinations that were done underground it was found that no possibility exists that any of these people survived the mud inundation into the mine," mine manager Peter Smith told state radio.
He did not say how deep underground the miners were.

The disaster happened late on Wednesday at Roberts Victor Diamond Mine, owned by Vancouver-listed Botswana Diamondfields Inc, near Delville, some 60 km (38 miles) west of the provincial capital Bloemfontein.
Police spokesman Captain Solly Lesia said continued rain had halted rescue operations, because of fears that more mud could flow into the diamond mine.
There was no word on when the hunt for the missing miners might resume.
Lesia said 32 miners had been rescued and two of them were seriously injured in the mudslide.
